// Reference code (not production): generated from Figma "Brownfield Design" > Explore - Viewport by tools/screen_code.py.
// DS names only (Music App Android design system); colors follow the Light / Dark theme.

import androidx.compose.foundation.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.*
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource

@Composable
fun ExploreViewportScreen(navigate: (String) -> Unit) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
    ) {
        StatusBar(time = "4:59", modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
        TopAppBar(
            title = stringResource(R.string.explore_caps),
            showActions = true,
            image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1767_17_1015),
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        )
        // Filter Chips
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            FilterChip(selected = true, label = stringResource(R.string.all))
            FilterChip(label = stringResource(R.string.arabic))
            FilterChip(label = stringResource(R.string.international))
            FilterChip(label = stringResource(R.string.podcasts))
        }
        // Shortcuts
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(start = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16, top = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16, end = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            ShortcutCard(
                label = stringResource(R.string.music_mix),
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1774_10_383),
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
            ShortcutCard(
                label = stringResource(R.string.recently_played),
                image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1775_10_383),
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
        }
        // Your new music Rail
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(top = AppTheme.spacing.spacing24),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            // Rail Header
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            ) {
                SectionHeader(
                    title = stringResource(R.string.your_new_music),
                    showMore = true,
                    showSupportingText = false,
                    supportingText = stringResource(R.string.discover_music_based_on_your_recent),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            // Rail Cards
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                    .padding(start = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            ) {
                MediaCard(
                    showBadge = false,
                    description = stringResource(R.string.your_next_favorite_songs_are_in),
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1780_10_386),
                    title = "ليالى",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.song),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
                MediaCard(
                    showBadge = true,
                    description = stringResource(R.string.your_next_favorite_songs_are_in),
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1781_10_386),
                    title = "The shadow beyond the...",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.album_yawn),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
                MediaCard(
                    showBadge = false,
                    description = stringResource(R.string.your_next_favorite_songs_are_in),
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1782_10_386),
                    title = "ماتمشيش",
                    subtitle = stringResource(R.string.song_2),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
            }
        }
        // For You Rail
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(top = AppTheme.spacing.spacing24),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            // Rail Header
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            ) {
                SectionHeader(
                    title = stringResource(R.string.for_you),
                    showMore = true,
                    showSupportingText = false,
                    supportingText = stringResource(R.string.discover_music_based_on_your_recent),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            // Rail Cards
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                    .padding(start = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            ) {
                MediaCard(
                    size = MediaCardSize.Large,
                    showBadge = false,
                    description = stringResource(R.string.your_next_favorite_songs_are_in),
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1787_17_986),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
                MediaCard(
                    size = MediaCardSize.Large,
                    showBadge = false,
                    description = stringResource(R.string.songs_you_loved_but_haven_t),
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1788_17_986),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
                MediaCard(
                    size = MediaCardSize.Large,
                    showBadge = false,
                    description = stringResource(R.string.throwback_hits_from_your_past),
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1789_17_986),
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
            }
        }
        // Dance Floor Egyptian Pop Rail
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(top = AppTheme.spacing.spacing24),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing8),
        ) {
            // Rail Header
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            ) {
                SectionHeader(
                    title = "Dance Floor Egyptian Pop",
                    showMore = false,
                    showSupportingText = false,
                    supportingText = stringResource(R.string.discover_music_based_on_your_recent),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            // Rail Cards
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                    .padding(start = AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(AppTheme.spacing.spacing16),
            ) {
                MediaCard(
                    showBadge = false,
                    description = stringResource(R.string.your_next_favorite_songs_are_in),
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1794_10_386),
                    title = "بالضحكة دى",
                    subtitle = "عمرو دياب",
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
                MediaCard(
                    showBadge = false,
                    description = stringResource(R.string.your_next_favorite_songs_are_in),
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1795_10_386),
                    title = "ونعيش",
                    subtitle = "عمرو دياب",
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
                MediaCard(
                    showBadge = false,
                    description = stringResource(R.string.your_next_favorite_songs_are_in),
                    image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1796_10_386),
                    title = "ومحمد...",
                    subtitle = "Amr Diab",
                    onClick = { navigate("now-playing") },
                )
            }
        }
        BottomNavigation(
            firstItem = NavigationItem(
                selected = true,
                label = stringResource(R.string.explore),
                icon = AppIcons.Explore,
            ),
            secondItem = NavigationItem(label = stringResource(R.string.search), icon = AppIcons.Search),
            thirdItem = NavigationItem(label = stringResource(R.string.connect), icon = AppIcons.Groups),
            fourthItem = NavigationItem(
                label = stringResource(R.string.your_library),
                icon = AppIcons.LibraryMusic,
            ),
            onChange = { index -> when (index) { 0 -> navigate("explore-viewport"); 1 -> navigate("search-discover-viewport"); 3 -> navigate("library-music") } },
        )
        MiniPlayer(
            image = painterResource(R.drawable.img_i_27_1819_10_451),
            title = "لو كنت غالى",
            subtitle = "مصطفى قمر",
            onOpen = { navigate("now-playing") },
        )
    }
}
